## Summary

CyberTAN Technology is a networking-equipment maker at Park Avenue III in the Science Based Park, Hsinchu, Taiwan, that offers OEM/ODM services alongside its SMB and enterprise, wired and wireless broadband, home connectivity and AI edge and IP camera product series [2]. The IEEE registry lists ten MA-L blocks to "CyberTAN Technology Inc.", all at 99 Park Avenue III, Hsinchu [1], and a business directory describes it as a manufacturer of broadband and wireless networking equipment [3].

A MAC in a CyberTAN block is most likely a router or access point sold under another brand: WikiDevi calls CyberTAN perhaps most recognizable for manufacturing many Linksys products, including most of the WRT54G series, and tags it on Cisco small-business, Western Digital, Viasat, Technicolor and Buffalo devices [4]. Silicon in those devices ranges from the Broadcom BCM4702 in the WRT54G v1.1 through Qualcomm IPQ8064 in the Linksys EA8500, IPQ4019 in the MR8300 and IPQ6028 in the MR7350 to MediaTek MT7621AT in the E7350, and the PHY modes WikiDevi lists run from 802.11b/g through 802.11ac to 802.11ax [4]. WikiDevi gives N89 as CyberTAN's FCC grantee code, and many of the Linksys models it lists, such as the WRT54G v1.1 and EA8500, carry Q87-prefixed FCC IDs instead [4].

Founding year and parent are not listed: the company site and the directory consulted do not state them, and the directory's parent field is paywalled [2][3]. No security advisory naming CyberTAN itself was found, since the NVD search pages did not render for the session that wrote this entry; advisories for the products it built are filed under the brand on the box [4]. Randomization is unknown.
